career_ladder.note: Laboratory Assistants (Prayogshala Sahayak) manage laboratory apparatus, practical experiments, chemical reagents, and specimen preparation across Secondary Education, College Education, Forensic Science Laboratories (FSL), and Agriculture departments in Rajasthan. Governed by their respective departmental subordinate service rules, they ensure safety protocols and experimental readiness for academic and forensic analysis.

exam_scheme.note: The Laboratory Assistant Direct Recruitment Examination is an objective written examination followed by certificate scrutiny. For Science posts (Secondary Education, College Education, Agriculture, and Forensic Science Laboratory), the examination comprises two separate papers of 200 marks each (total 400 marks). For Geography and Home Science posts, a single composite paper of 300 marks is administered. Negative marking of 1/3rd mark is applicable for each wrong response, and a minimum of 40% aggregate marks is mandatory to qualify.

financial_package.note: Laboratory Assistants are placed in Pay Matrix Level L-8 (Pay Band ₹9,300–₹34,800 with Grade Pay ₹2,800) under the Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2017. During the mandatory two-year probation period in Rajasthan, a fixed trainee remuneration of ₹18,500 per month is paid. Upon successful completion of probation, regular entry basic pay of ₹26,300 is drawn in Level L-8.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules 2017 Schedule Level L-8
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level L-8 entry basic pay of ₹26,300 at 58% DA (₹15,254 effective 01.07.2025), HRA (9% to 18%: ₹2,367 to ₹4,734), laboratory hazard allowance where applicable, net of State Insurance, General Provident Fund, and RGHS deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised semi-annually per Rajasthan Finance Department orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by district posting tier
Laboratory chemical and hazard risk allowance for chemical and forensic postings
Cashless medical facility across empanelled hospitals under RGHS
Defined pension coverage under restored Old Pension Scheme (OPS)
Privilege leave, causal leave, and annual leave travel concession (LTC)
